name: Spheal
description: During the season when drift ice approaches the shore, Spheal prefers living on the ice—where fewer predators lurk—rather than the land. Its fur retains heat superbly and resists harsh cold.

moves.name: Rollout
moves.description: The user rolls into the target to deal damage, then becomes fixated on using this move.

moves.name: Powder Snow
moves.description: The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow. This may also leave the target with frostbite.

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user restores its own HP but also becomes drowsy.

moves.name: Liquidation
moves.description: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.description: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target with frostbite.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the target. This may also leave the target with frostbite.
